stage1.impression: A flat, saturated red box floats in front of dark panelled boards with an elliptical hole cut in its top. It reads as a CG primitive, not cast acrylic: there is no glow through the thickness, the edges don't light up and the arrises are hard. The front face is a single dead red, the wood grain is procedural and stretched, the left fifth of the frame is crushed to black, and nothing shows anyone has been here. A design magazine would not run this as a specific place. It reads as a generic red trough in a sauna-like timber alcove, and nothing ties it to Planet EARF.

blocking_9: The sink must read as thick cast acrylic: light through its body, a bright polished lower edge and a gradient on the front face (front face lum_range >= 30, bottom strip brighter than the top of the face), not one flat red value with G=0
The basin's hot spot must not clip (basin clip_pct < 0.5) and must show a soft, rounded transition into the top, as the card describes, not a cut ellipse
The timber boards need real, non-repeating Douglas fir/oak grain with end checks, a satin sheen and board-to-board tone variation instead of the stretched procedural pattern
No region larger than a tenth of the frame may be more than half crushed (the left 80 px column currently sits at crush 89%)
Some sign of life at the sink: a linen towel, soap or a glass, warm and catching light
The odd flat pale rectangle at upper left (190-260, 60-190) must resolve into something identifiable or go dark
The frame needs a hint of the specific room (a sliver of board-formed concrete, a blackened-steel reveal, or a green glow from the zone) so it reads as Planet EARF and not as any bathroom

defects.what: The front face of the sink is a flat red (lum 11.9-26.6, R 89 G 0 B 2): it shows no glow through the thickness, gets darker toward the bottom despite the under-glow, and the green channel is clipped to zero
The basin hot spot clips at 8.8% and reads as a pink, plasticky hole. Its sharp elliptical lip does not match the card's 'soft and rounded into its top'
The sink's arrises are knife-sharp with no polished edge glow or radius, so it reads as a box primitive
This column (11% of the frame) is crushed: crush_pct 89.5, lum_median 0.2
The board grain is procedural, smeared and stretched vertically, uniformly glossy and too regular. The dark gaps between boards are pure black lines
An unexplained flat, pale grey rectangle with no texture or shading reads as a placeholder object
The spout is very small and high, its brushing doesn't read, it has no visible escutcheon, and it is cut off at the top of the frame
Nothing at the sink shows life or place. The frame median of 20.5 is below the 22-50 band

changes.problem: The sink doesn't glow through its thickness: the front face is a flat dark red that falls off toward the bottom, the opposite of being lit from below.

evidence.measured: profile y 21.7 -> 17.2 (darker at the bottom); front face [100,260,600,400] lum_median 19.5, lum_range 14.7

change.to: 3.0, plus a warm 2700 K LED strip (or a small area lamp, about 20 W) hidden under the trough's soffit and aimed up into its body so the lower edge and the face carry a gradient

changes.expected: The lower 20 mm of the face glows ember-orange, the face brightens toward its bottom edge, and the polished bottom arris reads as a line of light

changes.problem: The saturated red is gamut-clipped (G=0), which flattens the acrylic into one plastic value with no tonal modelling.

evidence.measured: R 89 G 0 B 2, lum_range 14.7, delta-E 21.9 vs #C8102E

change.to: AgX - Base (or Medium Low Contrast), keeping exposure set by c6

changes.expected: The red keeps a gradient and some orange in its brighter parts, and the face's tonal range widens

changes.problem: The sink spot burns the basin into a clipped pink hole.

change.to: 6 W, cone 40 deg, aimed at the back of the basin so the light grazes its curve rather than filling it

changes.expected: The basin reads as a rounded hollow, darker at its centre and lighter where it curves into the top, with no clipping

changes.problem: The left edge of the frame is a dead black slab.

change.setting: candles (a small prop) / a spill from the banquette side
change.from: no light reaching the left boards
change.to: a 1900 K candle in a smoked glass on a ledge just out of frame left (3 W point), or the nearest Dome downlight's spill let onto the left boards

changes.expected: The left boards hold dim grain at lum 8-15 and the frame keeps its low key

changes.problem: The timber is a stretched procedural grain with uniform gloss and pure-black joints, so it reads as CG laminate.

evidence.measured: lum_range 23.4; at 2x crop the grain is smeared vertical streaks with no checks or end grain

change.setting: the oak's stain / the boards' finish
change.to: a scanned rift-sawn oak or fir texture at real scale (boards 120-150 mm), random offset per board, roughness 0.55-0.7 with variation, a ±8% tone shift between boards, and joints at 6 mm with dark-brown shadow rather than black

changes.expected: The boards read as real timber at 1:1, with satin highlights from the sink glow

changes.problem: The frame sits slightly under the night-interior band.
changes.expected: Frame median about 26-32 with the basin still unclipped

changes.problem: Nothing shows life or tells you which room this is.

evidence.measured: the sink deck is bare; the only objects are the sink, the spout and the grey rectangle

change.to: a folded natural-linen hand towel on the deck's right end, a small amber glass soap bottle beside the basin, and a rocks glass left on the deck

changes.expected: Small warm highlights and a human scale cue on the deck, plus a neutral counterpoint to the red

changes.problem: The framing crops the spout at the top and gives a third of the frame to dark boards, so the alcove has no context.

evidence.measured: spout touches the top edge; the pale rectangle at [190,60,260,190] is unexplained

change.to: drop to about 1.05 m and look slightly up (verticals kept true by shift) at 40 mm, panned so the spout and its wall plate sit fully in frame and a sliver of board-formed concrete or the steel reveal of the alcove shows at one edge. Dim or reframe away the grey rectangle

changes.expected: The sink reads as a detail of a specific room, with the spout whole and the trough's underside and glow visible

out_of_scope.request: Give the trough rounded arrises (3-5 mm polished radii) and a basin that rolls softly into its top, as the card describes, instead of a sharp box with a cut ellipse
out_of_scope.why: The sink's form is fixed by the card. The model appears not to match its own description ('soft and rounded into its top'), so this is a model or spec question for the owner

out_of_scope.request: Show a visible thickness of acrylic (a deeper, more translucent body with a visible internal edge)
out_of_scope.why: This is the sink's design and material, which the card fixes
